description_en: Updates the channel configuration in the live packaging service, including the protocol, duration, and segment count
description_zh: 更新实时打包服务中的频道配置，包括协议、时长与切片数量等
kebab_example: aliyun ice update-live-package-channel --group-name channel-group-1 --description This_is_a_test_channel. --protocol HLS --segment-count 3 --segment-duration 6 --channel-name channel-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLivePackageChannel

parameters.help_en: The channel group name. The name can contain only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: [A-Za-z0-9-]+
parameters.help_zh: 频道组名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The input protocol. Currently, only HLS is supported
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The number of segments in the input stream m3u8 file. Valid values: 2 to 100
parameters.name: segment_count

parameters.help_en: The segment duration of the input stream. Valid values: 1 to 30
parameters.name: segment_duration

parameters.help_en: The channel name. The name can contain only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length. Format: [A-Za-z0-9-]+
parameters.help_zh: 频道名称，字符必须为大小写英文字母、数字、短横线、下划线。1 ~ 200个字符。格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+
parameters.name: channel_name
